primary_claim: A JAX-based mediating-object framework lets the same core Hessian-eigenspectrum code run unmodified across models trained in different platforms (PyTorch, TensorFlow), with only a small, reusable set of platform-specific adapter functions needing to change
stated_future_work: elaborate on reasons for choosing JAX in a future post
limitations_stated: code written for simplicity/clarity, not for compute or memory efficiency
runs on a single CPU/GPU/TPU only; distributed computation is out of scope
quote: In this post, we examined a proposed framework for platform-agnostic Hessian analysis (viz. eigenspectrum computation) of neural networks using a high-performance JAX backend.
